recognize_zh: 周邊血中大量小型成熟淋巴球，其中多顆細胞質內有圓形透明的球狀包涵體，並可見多個塗抹細胞（smudge cell）；箭頭所指的嗜中性球則沒有包涵體，顯示包涵體只出現在 CLL 淋巴球。
features: Absolute increase in small mature lymphocytes with high N:C ratio and condensed clumped chromatin
Several lymphocytes contain round, clear-to-pale globular cytoplasmic inclusions, often indenting the nucleus
Neutrophil (green arrow) with segmented nucleus and no inclusion
Red cells largely normocytic with a few scattered platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a lymphocytosis composed of small mature lymphocytes with condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm, accompanied by numerous smudge cells. A subset of lymphocytes contains round, pale globular cytoplasmic inclusions that indent the nucleus. A neighboring neutrophil lacks such inclusions. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with unusual lymphocyte cytoplasmic inclusions; flow cytometric immunophenotyping is required for confirmation.

ddx.dx: Lysosomal storage disease with vacuolated lymphocytes
ddx.vs: Storage disorders show multiple small punched-out vacuoles in non-clonal lymphocytes in young patients, without smudge cells or a monoclonal CD5+/CD23+ B-cell population.
LPL cells show plasmacytoid features and may contain Dutcher/Russell bodies that are PAS-positive, with an IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P.
MCL cells have more irregular nuclear contours and are CD23-negative, cyclin D1/SOX11-positive, which flow and IHC resolve.
Artifactual vacuoles appear in thick areas and affect all cell types, whereas these inclusions spare the neutrophil.
